programmes.d: A violent ruckus ensues after a man is placed in jail; secret prison communication methods are explored and examined; deputies cautiously extract a disruptive man while his wife is held nearby.

A woman is placed in isolation after disparaging other inmates; alarms blare while a fight erupts in the shower room among inmates; a man booked into jail is revealed to have a 20-year arrest record.

An inmate is subdued for refusing to follow commands; a woman whose accused of running out on a dinner bill has her jewelry sawed off in jail; after issuing criminal terrorist threats, a man is jailed.

Officers drive over a spike strip meant for their chase suspects; border patrol tracks an illegal alien into San Diego; a transgender is arrested for a stabbing; a supposed car thief's credibility is dismissed.

A drug suspect denies ownership of both his pants and his drugs; police bust a prostitute for the seventh time; an ex-convict's parole goes up in smoke when he is caught with drug paraphernalia; a bar patron is arrested.
